# Architecture

ZOE / JARVIS is an Electron + Python desktop AI OS. ONE command pipeline; everything else feeds it.

## Components
| Layer | Files | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Command pipeline | `tools/zoe_router.py` | the single brain: classify -> explain -> execute -> record (process/route) |
| Voice | `tools/zoe_assistant.py` | mic -> Deepgram -> router -> ElevenLabs; wake word, auto-calibrated mic |
| Command bar / 3D console | `tools/zoe_cli.py`, server `/command` | typed text -> same pipeline |
| Versioned kernel | `tools/zoe_versions.py`, `plugins/`, `tools/zoe_diagnostics.py` | locked schemas, plugin API, health |
| Runtime memory | `tools/zoe_state.py` | `memory/zoe_state.json` (session, history, workspace, mode) |
| Long-term memory | `tools/zoe_memory.py` | the Obsidian vault (`vault/`): write/read/sync/resume/graph |
| Electron shell | `electron/main.js` + services | window, tray, shortcuts, control :7766, auto-start, mic perm |
| Telemetry + API | `tools/zoe_server.py` :7717 | `/stats /3d /command /memory/* /session/resume /memory/graph` |
| UI | `zoe-ui/index.html` (deck), `zoe-ui/os3d.html` (3D graph), `electron/palette.html` (command bar) |
| Evolution / persistent memory | `tools/zoe_evolution.py`, `project-memory/` | auto-generated indexes (this system) |

## Data flow (a command)
```
voice/text/3D -> zoe_router.process() -> classify(Groq) -> execute -> POST :7766 (Electron) -> native action
             -> record to zoe_state + vault command log -> spoken/displayed reply
```

Backwards compatibility is a hard rule: features are extended, never removed. See `COMMAND_SYSTEM_GUIDE.md` for the full command reference and `memory-bank/handoff.md` for history.
